Manifesto.label: What is StayLooped?
Manifesto.body: StayLooped is a small, curated guide to Chiang Mai's best-loved tours and activities. We pick a tight shortlist of vetted operators — the ones with consistent reviews and the kind of experience we'd send a friend on.
Manifesto.bodyExtra: Bookings go straight to the operator. We earn a small commission on links you click, at no extra cost to you. That's what keeps this guide free.

Footer.tagline: Hand-picked things to do in Chiang Mai.
Footer.smallPrint: Affiliate disclosure: we earn a small commission on bookings made through links on this site — at no extra cost to you. Prices, availability, and inclusions are set by the operator and may change.
